hero.sub: Sources piling up, but hard to put to use?
hero.text: Find answers, refine documents, and reuse what you learn in your next task with Fruition.
hero.caption: Documents, wiki, and chat on one screen. Sample screen for illustration.

demo.title: Upload sources, find answers, and put them to work

upload.title: Upload and write
upload.body: Upload a PDF and get an editable Markdown document, tables included, so you can keep writing right away.

connect-ask.title: Ingest and ask
connect-ask.body: Ingest documents into the wiki and they connect in a graph. Ask a question and get answers grounded in what the wiki found.

edit-skill.title: Edit with AI, save as skills
edit-skill.body: Describe the change and AI marks suggestions in the text; only the ones you accept are applied. Save frequent requests as skills and reuse them.

pdf-upload.title: Upload and convert a PDF
pdf-upload.body: Choose Convert from the menu and a Markdown version appears next to the original PDF.
pdf-upload.label: Screen recording: uploading a PDF, converting it to Markdown from the menu, and opening the converted document with its tables

document-editor.title: Edit documents
document-editor.body: Type / to add headings, lists, and tables, and select text to change its formatting.
document-editor.label: Screen recording: writing a title in a new note, adding a list and a table from the / menu, and formatting text

wiki-ingest.title: Ingest into the wiki
wiki-ingest.body: Pick documents to ingest and watch the progress; when it finishes, new pages join the graph.
wiki-ingest.label: Screen recording: selecting documents to ingest into the wiki and seeing new pages connect in the graph when progress completes

wiki-lint.title: Refresh the wiki (Lint)
wiki-lint.body: Polishes wiki pages and adds newly found concepts and links to the graph.
wiki-lint.label: Screen recording: running a wiki refresh that polishes pages and grows concepts and links in the graph

query.title: Ask questions
query.body: Answers come from what the wiki found; click a number to jump to the supporting passage.
query.label: Screen recording: asking a question with a document open and clicking an answer's number to see the supporting passage

ai-edit.title: Edit with AI
ai-edit.body: Ask for a change and suggestions appear in the text. Accept one and only that change is applied.
ai-edit.label: Screen recording: asking AI for an edit, accepting the suggestion shown in the text, and reviewing the document reorganized into a table

skill-create.title: Create a skill
skill-create.body: Write the rules, refine them with AI, and check the result with a test run that leaves your documents unchanged.
skill-create.label: Screen recording: writing skill rules, refining them with AI, checking a test run, and saving the skill

skill-run.title: Run a skill
skill-run.body: Call a skill with a / command and it marks suggestions in the text using the same rules.
skill-run.label: Screen recording: running a skill with a / command in a memo and seeing suggestions appear in the text

together.name: Collaboration
together.title: Work together
together.headline: Grow personal notes into team knowledge
together.body: Invite teammates to share and build knowledge together in a workspace. Role-based access, automatic merging, and version history let many people safely build and manage knowledge.

chips.ingest: Ingest documents and chats into the wiki

access.title: Access
access.headline: Only people you allow can see it

items.encryption: Documents and original files are encrypted in storage.
items.https: Documents are transferred over encrypted connections (HTTPS).
items.members: Only workspace members can see documents, and you can grant edit or view access per folder and per document.
items.privateStorage: Original files are kept private, and links to open them have an expiration time.
items.embedding: Document analysis for search (embeddings) is processed within Fruition.
items.redaction: In text-based AI requests, content detected as numeric personal data is masked before sending.
items.autoIngestOff: Auto-ingest, where AI processes documents as soon as they're uploaded, is off by default and starts only after the workspace owner turns it on.
items.trash: Deleted documents can be restored from the trash for 30 days. After the retention period, documents and original files are processed for permanent deletion.
items.deletePermission: Only the document owner and the workspace owner can delete or restore documents.

difference.question: How is this different from a regular AI chat?
difference.answer: Your uploaded documents are organized into a wiki, and answers are grounded in that wiki. Each answer shows which documents it referenced.

sources.question: What can I upload?
sources.answer: Upload PDF, Markdown, or TXT documents, or write documents right in the app. Record meetings or upload recordings to keep them as minutes.

ingest.question: Do uploaded documents go into the wiki right away?
ingest.answer: Depending on your workspace settings, they're ingested automatically, or you can pick only the documents you want.

availability.question: Can I try it now?
availability.answer: Fruition is in a test run. Features and screens may change.

problems.label: The hard part starts after saving
problems.title: Back to the beginning. Every time.
problems.body: Even with your sources saved, using them means finding, reading, and organizing them all over again.
problems.findBody: You search through documents, meeting notes, and conversations for something you have already read.
problems.connectTitle: “Found it. Now I have to read it all.”
problems.connectBody: You read across scattered sources and work out how the pieces fit together.
problems.reuseBody: When insights and workflows are not saved, you repeat the same writing and editing work.

solution.label: How Fruition helps
solution.title: From saved sources to your next task.
solution.body: Connect your sources, find the answers you need, and use them in your documents and recurring work.
solution.findBody: Add documents to your wiki and ask questions about them. Follow the citations to check the original text.
solution.connectBody: Explore concepts and relationships across documents in your wiki and graph. Save useful conversations as documents to add to your wiki.
solution.reuseBody: Ask AI to edit a document and accept the suggestions you need. Save recurring requests as skills to run with the same rules next time.
